name: ad-studio
description: AD Studio adds audio description (narration of what is on screen) to videos. It watches the video with a vision model (Ollama or Gemini), writes short descriptions, voices them with Kokoro and mixes them into a descriptive audio track (or a longer video that pauses for them). Nothing is kept on the server: results are downloaded and deleted when the browser tab closes. Needs Whisper, Ollama and Kokoro services reachable over HTTP.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Holds only settings.json (and the saved Gemini key when KEY_MODE=server). Must be writable by nobody:users.

paths.name: Scratch
paths.description: Temporary working files and uploads, one folder per browser tab, deleted when the tab closes and wiped at startup. Put it on the cache pool, not in docker.img.

variables.name: Whisper URL
variables.description: Whisper (whisper-asr-webservice) address, e.g. http://SERVER-IP:9000

variables.name: Ollama URL
variables.description: Ollama address, e.g. http://SERVER-IP:11434 (not needed if you only use Gemini)

variables.name: Kokoro URL
variables.description: Kokoro-FastAPI address including /v1, e.g. http://SERVER-IP:8880/v1

variables.name: Vision backend
variables.description: local = Ollama, gemini = Google Gemini (cloud).

variables.name: Vision model
variables.description: Ollama vision model.

variables.name: Gemini model
variables.description: Used when the backend is Gemini.

variables.name: Gemini API key
variables.description: Shared Gemini key (only used when Key mode is server).

variables.name: Key mode
variables.description: user = each visitor types their own Gemini key, kept only in their browser tab (safest, required if the app is exposed to the internet). server = one shared key stored on this server.

variables.name: Change sensitivity
variables.description: Changes mode: 1 (only page switches) to 10 (almost any change). 5 catches writing and page switches.

variables.name: Min seconds between descriptions
variables.description: Changes mode: fewest seconds between two descriptions (1-60).

variables.name: Max wait for sentence break (s)
variables.description: Changes mode: longest a description may wait to start at the end of a sentence (0-30; 0 = at the change).

variables.name: Placement mode
variables.description: pauses (fit in pauses), talkover (talk over speaker), extended (pause the video) or changes (describe screen changes, no pausing).

variables.name: Shortest pause (s)
variables.description: Pauses mode: shortest silence to use.

variables.name: Describe every (s)
variables.description: Talk over / extended: about how often to describe.

variables.name: Max words
variables.description: Talk over / extended: maximum words per description.

variables.name: Words per second
variables.description: Pauses mode: speaking rate used to size descriptions.

variables.name: Duck (dB)
variables.description: How far to turn the original audio down under narration.

variables.name: Narration gain (dB)
variables.description: Narration volume.

variables.name: Frames per description
variables.description: Frames sent to the local vision model per description.

variables.name: Voice
variables.description: Kokoro voice id.

variables.name: Batch review time (s)
variables.description: Seconds to review each video's descriptions before it is built.

variables.name: Session TTL (hours)
variables.description: Safety net: delete sessions idle longer than this.
